Best for: Alexa households happy to pay the monthly plan
Main catch: Saves no video at all unless you pay £4.99 a month.
Local storage: None. No on-device or hub storage.
Smart detection: Paid (person, package and vehicle alerts on Ring's plans page)
What's paywalled: All recording and playback (up to 180 days), smart alerts, Extended Live View; 24/7 recording is £3/month extra per device
Subscription & UK price: Ring Solo £4.99/month or £49.99/year (1 device). Multi £7.99/month, AI Pro £15.99/month
Home Assistant / local-only: Official integration, but it goes through Ring's cloud. No local-only option.

Best for: Google Home households who want polished smart alerts
Main catch: Only 3 hours of free history. Anything longer is £8 a month.
Smart detection: Free: person, parcel, animal and vehicle alerts; Google sells 'smarter' AI notifications as Premium
What's paywalled: 30 or 60 days of history, AI notifications, familiar faces, Gemini search. No 24/7 recording on this model at any price
Home Assistant / local-only: Official integration, but it goes through Google's cloud (Cloud Push) and needs a one-off US$5 Google developer fee.

Best for: Busy doorsteps with lots of parcels: a second camera looks straight down
Main catch: Expensive, Home Assistant support is unofficial, and eufy had a cloud-privacy scandal in 2022.
Local storage: 8 GB in the doorbell; optional HomeBase S380 (16 GB, expandable)
Smart detection: Free: person and package detection on the device
What's paywalled: Nothing essential; cloud backup is optional
Subscription & UK price: Optional Cloud Backup £3.99/month or £39.99/year (1 device); £12.99/month for all devices
Home Assistant / local-only: Community add-on only (eufy_security), which still logs in through your eufy account.

Best for: Homes with existing doorbell wiring, plus Home Assistant or NVR users
Main catch: Needs doorbell transformer wiring, and the microSD card is sold separately.
Local storage: microSD (up to 256 GB) and/or a Reolink NVR; RTSP/ONVIF
Recorded history without subscription: Yes, motion-triggered or 24/7 recording to card or NVR
Subscription & UK price: Optional Reolink Cloud. UK £4.58/month, or £2.71/month billed yearly (£32.52/year) for 1 camera
Home Assistant / local-only: Official, fully local integration (Local Push, top 'Platinum' quality rating); works with no internet connection.

Best for: The most reliable, fully local setup, if you can run an Ethernet cable
Main catch: Needs an Ethernet cable to the door and a PoE switch or injector.
Subscription & UK price: None. Reolink's doorbell FAQ says the PoE model cannot use Reolink Cloud; it records to microSD or an NVR
Home Assistant / local-only: Official, fully local integration (Local Push, Platinum).

Price note: Screwfix, includes 64 GB card (Reolink UK also £99.99)
Best for: Battery install with 5 GHz Wi-Fi and no fees
Main catch: Footage sits on a card in the doorbell itself unless you add a £109.99 Home Hub (bundle £180.49).
Local storage: microSD in the doorbell, or a Home Hub indoors (up to 1 TB)
Smart detection: Free: person, vehicle and package detection
Subscription & UK price: Optional Reolink Cloud. UK £4.17/month, or £2.87/month billed yearly (£34.44/year) for up to 5 cameras
Home Assistant / local-only: Official integration through a Reolink Home Hub or NVR, which streams the battery doorbell locally.

Best for: An easy battery doorbell that keeps footage indoors on its chime/hub
Main catch: The microSD card is extra, and Home Assistant gets settings and alerts but not the live video.
Local storage: microSD (up to 512 GB) in the indoor H200 hub
What's paywalled: 30-day cloud history, snapshot notifications, Smart Sort
Home Assistant / local-only: Official TP-Link Smart Home integration, polled locally for settings and motion alerts. Hub-attached cameras still have no live view in Home Assistant.

Main catch: Basic, and the microSD card sits in the doorbell, so a thief takes the footage with it.
Local storage: microSD up to 512 GB, in the doorbell itself
What's paywalled: 30-day cloud history, snapshot notifications, Smart Sort
Home Assistant / local-only: Not listed as supported by Home Assistant's official TP-Link integration, and no local route is documented.

Price note: Argos half price, doorbell + chime bundle (was £169.99)
Best for: People who already own Arlo cameras
Main catch: Recording needs a £7.99/month plan or a separate hub costing about £105.
Local storage: Only through an Arlo SmartHub (VMB4540, USB) or a Base Station
What's paywalled: Cloud recording (7, 14 or 30 days depending on plan), object detection, activity zones, theft replacement
Subscription & UK price: Arlo Secure £7.99/month (1 camera, 7 days), Multi-Camera £12.99, Secure Plus £19.99 (14 days), Secure Pro £24.99
Home Assistant / local-only: No official integration; only a community add-on that goes through Arlo's cloud.

Main catch: Runs on AA batteries unless wired, and setting it up in Home Assistant is fiddly.
Local storage: microSD (up to 512 GB) in the indoor chime
Smart detection: Free: face recognition on the device
Recorded history without subscription: Yes, on the chime's card (24/7 only when wired)
What's paywalled: Nothing essential. HomeKit Secure Video needs Apple's paid iCloud+
Home Assistant / local-only: Reported to work locally through Home Assistant's HomeKit Device integration; two-way audio isn't available there.

Price note: Amazon UK RRP (deals as low as £29.99)
Best for: The cheapest way into Amazon's ecosystem, if you catch a deal
Main catch: Saves nothing without a £40 Sync Module 2 and a USB stick, and live view cuts off after 5 minutes.
Local storage: Only through a Sync Module 2 + USB stick (1–256 GB); clips aren't encrypted
What's paywalled: Cloud clips, person/vehicle detection, 90-minute live view, AI descriptions
Home Assistant / local-only: Official integration, but it goes through Blink's cloud.

Best for: Two cameras on a budget, with storage built in
Main catch: Expert Reviews found its motion detection unreliable and the app confusing.
Local storage: 32 GB built in, no card needed
Subscription & UK price: Optional CloudPlay. UK price is app-only; EU €4.99/month (7 days), so treat the plan column as an estimate
Home Assistant / local-only: Official integration, but it goes through EZVIZ's cloud; this battery model isn't named in its supported list.
Unverified / re-check: CloudPlay's UK price is app-only, so the £4.99 in the plan column is the published EU price, not a UK quote.

Best for: Flats and rentals: no wiring, and footage stays indoors in the chime
Main catch: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only, and the card is sold separately.
Local storage: microSD (up to 256 GB) in the included indoor chime
Subscription & UK price: Optional CloudPlay. UK price is app-only; EU €4.99/month (7 days), so treat the plan column as an estimate
Home Assistant / local-only: Official integration, but it goes through EZVIZ's cloud; this battery model isn't named in its supported list.
Unverified / re-check: CloudPlay's UK price is app-only, so the £4.99 in the plan column is the published EU price, not a UK quote.

Price note: Only UK listing found (fitted install); the model is discontinued
Best for: Only worth it if an installer is fitting a Hikvision system anyway
Main catch: Discontinued by Hikvision, and the only UK listing we found is a fitted install at £295.
Local storage: microSD up to 128 GB; RTSP to an NVR
Home Assistant / local-only: Works as a generic RTSP camera.
